export.title: Your data
export.hint: Your data lives only on this device. If you clear the browser data, it is gone.
export.excelHint: Exercises, routines and sets in a multi-sheet workbook
export.csvHint: One sheet per download, no network needed
export.backupHint: A JSON file to move your data to another device
export.importHint: JSON, Excel or CSV. Replaces what is here now. A Lomito Workouts plan is added without deleting anything
export.importConfirmText: This will replace your {{exercises}} exercises and {{routines}} routines with the contents of the file. This cannot be undone.
export.pdfHint: With blank boxes to write in at the gym
export.failed: The file could not be generated
export.importFailed: That file is not a valid Lomito Train backup
export.importDiscarded: {{count}} items were discarded because they did not have the expected shape
export.importPlanText: “{{title}}” will be added: {{routines}} routines and {{exercises}} exercises. Your current exercises, routines and sets are kept. Exercises with the same name are reused and routines with the same name are updated.
export.importedPlan: Plan imported: {{created}} new exercises, {{reused}} reused and {{routines}} routines
export.planTooNew: This plan comes from a newer version of Lomito Workouts. Update Lomito Train and try again

unit.label: Weight unit
unit.hint: Your data is always stored in kilograms. Changing the unit only changes how it is shown.

install.title: Install on this device
install.hint: With its own icon, full screen and offline. The data is the same as in the browser.
install.ios: In Safari, tap Share and then Add to Home Screen.
install.manual: Look for Install app in your browser menu.
install.failed: The install dialog could not be opened
